meaning: Explicit ownership ledger, not a claim that static validation substitutes for behavioral or live UI testing.

workflows.title: Connection and initialization
workflows.notes: The reference app advertises explicit gateway OAuth and probes readiness before model/inference startup.

workflows.title: Managed account login, cancellation and logout
workflows.notes: The app offers device-code and API-key sign-in; other typed login variants belong to SDK hosts and the Bedrock workflow.

workflows.title: Explicit gateway OAuth readiness and sign-in
workflows.notes: A failed probe does not fall back. URLs are scoped to initiated login; canceled or replaced flows cannot publish late state.

workflows.title: Local verification and MCP approval proof
workflows.notes: Cancel uses the original RPC ID on its original connection. Local key enrollment/deletion does not claim backend registration/revocation.

workflows.title: Amazon Bedrock discovery and setup
workflows.notes: Profile/environment and direct credentials use account/login/start variants; provider changes reconnect before catalog refresh.

workflows.title: Capabilities, usage, workspace messages and billing
workflows.notes: Multiple limit buckets and reset-credit inventory are preserved. Credit redemption retains an idempotency identity after uncertain outcomes; emails require confirmation.

workflows.title: Model, collaboration and permission selection
workflows.notes: Catalog metadata and canonical active-thread settings drive the host selectors.

workflows.title: Reviewed feedback upload
workflows.notes: Category/note, optional selected chat, logs, extra host-local files and tags are reviewed before one explicit upload; no automatic retries.

workflows.title: Chat lifecycle and selected transcript hydration
workflows.notes: Lease close owns unsubscribe. Sidebar mutations, new/resumed/forked chats and compaction are real host workflows.

workflows.title: Projects, sections and sidebar search
workflows.notes: Project identity is independent of its primary root. Pagination keeps separate cursors and roots.

workflows.title: Turn submission, steering, live settings and review
Streaming transcript, tools, hooks and Guardian reviews
Realtime Voice over WebRTC
workflows.notes: V3 validates against the v1 voice catalog. Voice/model/output choices apply to the next session; item IDs own transcript utterances.

workflows.title: Realtime PCM transport for SDK hosts
workflows.notes: SDK hosts supply PCM frames and consume typed audio events. The reference app sends microphone audio through WebRTC, not this RPC.

workflows.title: Remote access, pairing and revocation
workflows.notes: Binding only observes; enable/disable and client revocation are confirmed actions. Pairing secrets expire and are dropped on hide, claim, replacement, or disconnect.

workflows.title: Executor environment setup and inspection
workflows.notes: Status never triggers recovery. Shell information explicitly starts/recovers the executor. Bearer authentication requires a secure or literal loopback destination.

workflows.title: File operations, watches and file mentions
Processes, terminal commands and PTY control
External agent configuration migration
workflows.notes: The import observer is registered before dispatch, preserving completion-before-response and partial migration receipts.

workflows.title: Experimental flags and local rollout compression
Skills, apps, plugins, hooks and marketplaces
workflows.notes: Search, details, skill contents/root edits, reconciliation, installation and marketplace changes have actual catalog/sheet actions.

workflows.title: Lossless versioned runtime configuration changes
workflows.notes: Fresh server configuration is hydrated before edits and expected versions retained; arbitrary MCP fields are not reconstructed from a lossy subset.

workflows.title: Scoped MCP resources, tools, streams and widgets
workflows.notes: Streams observe before dispatch and stop on ambiguous starts. Widgets receive scoped resource/tool access with sandboxed initialize/input/result, fullscreen and context callbacks.

workflows.title: Windows-only sandbox capabilities
workflows.notes: Typed SDK setup/readiness and notifications are available to Windows-capable hosts. The macOS reference app has no Windows setup UI.

workflows.title: Upstream internal mock method
workflows.notes: Generated sealed protocol surface only. Deliberately excluded from product workflow claims.

workflows.title: Scoped SDK host elicitation lifecycle
workflows.notes: SDK hosts pause a thread around host-owned interactions. Paired cleanup is guarded by the lease connection epoch; the reference app uses the server-owned MCP approval lifecycle.

workflows.title: Side-chat fork boundary injection
workflows.notes: After an ephemeral fork the app clears inherited goals and injects an explicit side-conversation boundary before inference; obsolete selection closes the lease.

workflows.title: Model requirements, auth recovery, safety and typed warnings
workflows.notes: Connection/thread/turn selection scopes notices. Typed user-facing warning fields and from/to model names remain actionable; native/provider payloads and moderation blobs are summarized without rendering raw values.

workflows.title: Command, file, permission and legacy approval prompts
workflows.notes: Typed inbox request keys and schema-validated response variants guard approval. Resolved or replaced requests cannot accept stale UI answers.

workflows.title: Tool user input and MCP form, URL or native verification
workflows.notes: MCP form, URL and openai/userVerification requests are distinct typed variants. Native proof is accepted only while its exact request is still pending; canceled or obsolete proof is discarded.

workflows.title: Reference-host dynamic thread tools
workflows.notes: The app registers and handles its documented thread tools; SDK hosts register their own tools and validate results through the same server-request seam.

workflows.title: Local host attestation response
workflows.notes: The local host answers the typed request using its attestation provider; logging records byte count only, never token content.

workflows.title: External ChatGPT token host extension
workflows.notes: SDK hosts using chatgptAuthTokens supply the refresh handler and own secret lifecycle. The reference app uses managed login, API keys or Bedrock and does not instantiate external-token auth. An unconfigured host returns a capability error, never stale credentials.
